source: Task 15 review fixes, 2026-10-14: native taps that separate what the lift follows (direction, the target segment, the distance), captured with the VK-550 spike probe (SegFid, a pure-UIKit UISegmentedControl screen, -mode seg -bg plain) on an iOS 26.5 iPhone 17 Pro simulator (Xcode 27.0), touches by idb (tap --duration 0.07, 1.5 s apart), each sequence run three times in one launch: full5 (-trace 3) from segment 1 to 2, 1, 3, 1, 5, 1, 4, 3, 5, 3, 2, 1; full3 (-trace 1) to 2, 3, 2, 1, 3, 1; full2 (-trace 2) to 2, 1; full3 right to left (-AppleTextDirection YES -NSForceRightToLeftWritingDirection YES; segment 1 at the right) to 2, 3, 2, 1, 3, 1. Every touch delivered within 28.1 ms; valueChanged 4.2 to 25.0 ms after the touch-up. Rows as native_reference.json (the same extraction): CADisplayLink presentation frames of _UILiquidLensView, x the lens centre control-local in screen coordinates (full width 370 at x 16), engage opacityPair.inputAmount, t from valueChanged, every 0.05 s to 0.9 s.
split: Fixed before any capture was looked at: the first run of each sequence (pass 0) joins the fitting set; the second and third (passes 1 and 2) are a holdout, never fitted.
